examples.ko: 그 직원이 경쟁 회사와 몰래 내통했어요.
examples.en: That employee secretly colluded with a rival company.

examples.ko: 적과 내통한 사람이 누구인지 아직 몰라요.
examples.en: We still don't know who was in secret contact with the enemy.

examples.ko: 영화 속 스파이는 적국과 내통해서 정보를 넘겼어요.
examples.en: The spy in the movie passed on information by secretly working with the enemy country.

examples.ko: 둘이 내통하고 있다는 소문이 회사에 돌았어요.
examples.en: A rumor went around the company that the two were secretly in cahoots.

examples.ko: 누군가 외부 사람과 내통하는 것 같아요.
examples.en: It seems someone is secretly in contact with an outsider.

examples.ko: 그는 내통했다는 의심 때문에 조사를 받았어요.
examples.en: He was investigated because he was suspected of secret collusion.

explain: 주로 적이나 외부 사람과 나쁜 목적으로 몰래 손을 잡을 때 써요. 뉴스나 영화 줄거리에서 많이 보이고, 일상 대화에서는 '짜고 하다'처럼 말하기도 해요.
explain_en: It is used when someone secretly joins hands with an enemy or outsider for a bad purpose. You see it in news and film plots, while in everyday talk people may say '짜고 하다' (to act in collusion).

examples.ko: 저는 내향성이 강해서 사람 많은 곳이 피곤해요.
examples.en: I'm quite introverted, so crowded places tire me out.

examples.ko: 내향성인 사람도 발표를 잘할 수 있어요.
examples.en: Introverted people can give good presentations too.

examples.ko: 내향성과 외향성 중에서 나는 어디에 가까울까요?
examples.en: Between introversion and extroversion, which am I closer to?

examples.ko: 친구는 내향성 성격이라 조용한 카페를 좋아해요.
examples.en: My friend has an introverted personality, so she likes quiet cafés.
Introversion is not a flaw but just one type of personality.

examples.ko: 제 동생은 내향성 때문에 낯선 모임을 힘들어해요.
examples.en: My younger sibling finds unfamiliar gatherings hard because of introversion.

explain: 반대말은 '외향성'이에요. 사람을 직접 말할 때는 '내향적이다', '내향적인 사람'이 더 자연스럽고, '내향성'은 성격 특성을 설명할 때 써요.
explain_en: The opposite is '외향성' (extroversion). When describing a person directly, '내향적이다' or '내향적인 사람' sounds more natural, while '내향성' is used to talk about the trait itself.

examples.ko: 그는 화가 나서 문을 냅다 걷어찼어요.
examples.en: He was angry and kicked the door hard.

examples.ko: 비가 오자 아이들이 집으로 냅다 뛰어갔어요.
examples.en: When the rain started, the kids dashed home at full speed.

examples.ko: 친구가 공을 냅다 던지는 바람에 깜짝 놀랐어요.
examples.en: My friend hurled the ball so hard that I was startled.

examples.ko: 소리를 냅다 지르고 나니 속이 시원했어요.
examples.en: After I yelled at the top of my lungs, I felt relieved.
A dog suddenly came charging at me, so I ran away.

examples.ko: 그 사람은 말도 없이 내 어깨를 냅다 쳤어요.
examples.en: That person whacked my shoulder without saying a word.

explain: 힘차고 거칠게, 망설임 없이 갑자기 하는 행동에 써요. '걷어차다, 던지다, 뛰다, 지르다' 같은 동작 동사와 잘 어울리고, 말할 때 생생한 느낌을 줘요.
explain_en: It describes an action done forcefully, roughly and suddenly without hesitation. It goes well with action verbs like '걷어차다', '던지다', '뛰다' and '지르다', and gives a vivid feel in speech.

examples.ko: 혼자 냉가슴만 앓지 말고 얘기해 보세요.
examples.en: Don't suffer in silence alone; try talking about it.

examples.ko: 그는 말도 못 하고 냉가슴을 앓았어요.
examples.en: He couldn't say anything and just fretted in silence.
I finally confided the thing that had been eating at me.

examples.ko: 며느리가 눈치를 보며 냉가슴을 앓고 있어요.
examples.en: The daughter-in-law is worrying silently, watching everyone's mood.

examples.ko: 이렇게 냉가슴 앓는 것도 이제 지쳤어요.
examples.en: I'm tired of agonizing in silence like this.

examples.ko: 돈 문제로 몇 달째 냉가슴을 앓고 있어요.
examples.en: I've been quietly worrying about money for months.

explain: 거의 '냉가슴을 앓다'의 모양으로 써요. 남에게 말 못 하고 속으로만 끙끙 걱정하는 상황이고, 비슷한 말로 '속앓이'가 있어요.

phrases.example: 말도 못 하고 혼자 냉가슴을 앓았어요.
phrases.en: to suffer in silence over a worry
phrases.nuance_ko: 말하기 어려운 걱정을 속으로만 품고 괴로워할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you keep a hard-to-share worry inside and suffer over it.

explain_en: It is almost always used in the form '냉가슴을 앓다'. It describes worrying inwardly because you can't tell anyone, and a similar word is '속앓이'.

examples.en: A cooling-off period has come over relations between the two countries.

examples.ko: 싸운 뒤에 우리는 냉각기를 가지기로 했어요.
examples.en: After the fight, we decided to take a cooling-off period.
The market entered a cooling phase and transactions dropped.

examples.ko: 냉각기 동안 감정을 정리할 수 있었어요.
examples.en: During the cooling-off period, I was able to sort out my feelings.

examples.ko: 냉각기가 길어지면 관계가 멀어질 수 있어요.
examples.en: If the cooling-off period gets long, the relationship may drift apart.

examples.ko: 서로 냉각기를 갖고 다시 이야기해 봐요.
examples.en: Let's take some time to cool off and then talk again.

explain: 사람 사이나 나라 관계, 시장 분위기가 식어서 잠시 거리를 두는 시기를 말할 때 써요. 기계에서 열을 식히는 장치도 '냉각기'라고 해서 문맥으로 구분해요.
explain_en: It refers to a period when a relationship, ties between countries or market mood cools and people keep some distance. A device that cools machinery is also called '냉각기', so context tells them apart.

examples.ko: 두 회사 사이에 냉기류가 흐르고 있어요.
examples.en: A chill hangs between the two companies.
A cold tension filled the meeting room, so it was hard to speak.

examples.ko: 선거 뒤에 두 당 사이의 냉기류는 풀리지 않았어요.
examples.en: After the election, the chill between the two parties did not thaw.
Because of the chilly atmosphere, the negotiations stalled for a while.
After I apologized, the chill eased a little.
I felt a chill between the couple and it was uncomfortable.

explain: 차가운 공기 흐름이라는 날씨 말로도 쓰지만, 사람이나 나라 사이의 차갑고 어색한 분위기를 비유하는 일이 많아요. 보통 '흐르다, 감돌다, 풀리다'와 함께 써요.

phrases.example: 두 사람 사이에 냉기류가 흐르고 있어요.
phrases.en: for a chilly atmosphere to hang between people
phrases.nuance_ko: 사이가 나빠서 분위기가 차갑고 어색할 때 비유로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figurative way to say the mood is cold and awkward because relations are bad.
phrases.en_equiv: a chill hangs in the air

explain_en: It can mean a flow of cold air in weather talk, but it is often used figuratively for a cold, awkward mood between people or countries. It usually goes with '흐르다', '감돌다' and '풀리다'.

examples.en: It hurt that his family treated him coldly.
If you treat customers coldly, the shop's reputation gets worse.

examples.ko: 새로 온 직원을 냉대하는 분위기가 싫어요.
examples.en: I dislike the atmosphere of giving the new employee the cold shoulder.
That person treated me far too coldly.
I felt my relatives were cold to me, so I stopped visiting.

examples.ko: 이웃이 냉대해도 저는 늘 먼저 인사해요.
examples.en: Even if the neighbors are cold to me, I always greet them first.

explain: 사람을 차갑고 무심하게 대할 때 써요. 반대말은 '환대하다'이고, 비슷한 말로 '푸대접하다'가 있어요. 받는 쪽에서는 '냉대를 받다'라고도 말해요.
explain_en: It is used when you treat someone in a cold, careless way. The opposite is '환대하다' and a similar word is '푸대접하다'. From the receiver's side you can also say '냉대를 받다'.

examples.en: My uncle answered in a cold tone.

examples.ko: 싸운 뒤로 집 안 분위기가 냉랭해요.
examples.en: Since the fight, the mood at home has been frosty.
The boss's face was cold from the morning, which was scary.

examples.ko: 두 사람 사이가 냉랭해진 지 오래됐어요.
examples.en: It has been a long time since the two grew cold toward each other.
I greeted them, but the response was cold.
I was hurt by the cold attitude.

explain: 온도보다 분위기, 말투, 표정, 사이가 차가울 때 많이 써요. '쌀쌀하다'는 날씨에도 쓰지만 '냉랭하다'는 주로 사람 쪽 이야기에 어울리고, 반대로는 '다정하다'가 있어요.
explain_en: It is mostly used for a cold mood, tone, expression or relationship rather than temperature. '쌀쌀하다' also works for weather, but '냉랭하다' suits talk about people, and the opposite is '다정하다'.

examples.ko: 에어컨 냉매가 새면 시원한 바람이 잘 안 나와요.
examples.en: If the air conditioner's refrigerant leaks, the cool air doesn't come out well.

examples.ko: 냉매를 새로 채우는 데 돈이 얼마나 들까요?
examples.en: How much would it cost to refill the refrigerant?
There is refrigerant inside a refrigerator too.

examples.ko: 냉매가 부족한 것 같으니 기사님을 부르세요.
examples.en: It seems the refrigerant is low, so call a technician.

examples.ko: 이 에어컨은 환경에 덜 해로운 냉매를 써요.
examples.en: This air conditioner uses a refrigerant that is less harmful to the environment.

examples.ko: 냉매 가스를 함부로 버리면 안 돼요.
examples.en: You must not dispose of refrigerant gas carelessly.

explain: 에어컨이나 냉장고 안에서 열을 옮겨 차갑게 만들어 주는 물질이에요. 고장 수리 이야기에서 '냉매가 새다', '냉매를 채우다'처럼 자주 나와요.
explain_en: It is the substance inside air conditioners and refrigerators that moves heat to make things cold. In repair talk you hear phrases like '냉매가 새다' and '냉매를 채우다'.

examples.en: He always talks in a cynical tone.
The mood sank because of the cynical reaction.
Don't look at the world so cynically.

examples.ko: 냉소적인 사람이라고 해서 차갑기만 한 건 아니에요.
examples.en: A cynical person is not necessarily just cold.
That movie portrays society in a cynical way.
My friend's dry, sardonic joke made me laugh.

explain: 무엇이든 비웃듯이 차갑고 비꼬는 태도를 말해요. 보통 '냉소적인 말투', '냉소적으로 보다'처럼 '인/으로'가 붙은 모양으로 써요.
explain_en: It describes a cold, sneering attitude toward everything. It usually appears with endings, as in '냉소적인 말투' and '냉소적으로 보다'.

examples.ko: 이것은 어디까지나 현실이며 냉엄한 삶 그 자체예요.
examples.en: This is reality through and through, and life in all its harshness.
Reality is harsher than you think.
You have to survive in the harsh competition.
We have to accept the market's unforgiving judgment.

examples.ko: 냉엄한 현실을 알고 나서 더 열심히 준비했어요.
examples.en: After learning how harsh reality is, I prepared even harder.
The referee applied the rules strictly and without mercy.

explain: 현실, 경쟁, 평가처럼 사정을 봐주지 않는 상황에 어울려요. 사람의 차가운 태도에는 '냉정하다'를 더 많이 쓰고, '냉엄하다'는 글이나 뉴스에서 자주 보여요.
explain_en: It suits situations that show no mercy, such as reality, competition or evaluation. For a person's cold attitude '냉정하다' is more common, and '냉엄하다' often appears in writing and news.

en: heating and cooling unit (air conditioner and heater)

examples.ko: 우리 사무실에는 냉온풍기가 한 대 있어요.
examples.en: There is one heating and cooling unit in our office.
In winter we heat the room with the heating and cooling unit.

examples.ko: 냉온풍기 필터를 한 달에 한 번 청소해요.
examples.en: I clean the unit's filter once a month.

examples.ko: 여름에 냉온풍기를 켜면 방이 금방 시원해져요.
examples.en: In summer, when I turn the unit on, the room cools down quickly.
The unit broke down, so I called the service center.

examples.ko: 새 냉온풍기는 소리가 별로 안 나요.
examples.en: The new unit doesn't make much noise.

explain: 찬바람과 따뜻한 바람이 둘 다 나오는 기계예요. 그냥 '에어컨'이라고 부르는 사람도 많지만, 겨울에 난방까지 되는 제품을 가리킬 때 이 말을 써요.
explain_en: It is a machine that blows both cool and warm air. Many people simply say '에어컨', but this word is used for a unit that also heats in winter.

examples.en: In summer, jellyfish naengchae whets the appetite.
They served naengchae first as part of the feast.
You pour mustard sauce on this naengchae.
My mother made shrimp naengchae for us.

examples.ko: 냉채는 차게 먹는 요리라서 더운 날 좋아요.
examples.en: Naengchae is eaten cold, so it's nice on a hot day.
I ordered naengchae at a Chinese restaurant and it was refreshing.

explain: 여러 재료를 차게 해서 소스에 버무려 먹는 요리예요. 겨자나 식초가 들어간 새콤한 소스와 자주 먹고, 코스 요리에서는 처음에 나오는 경우가 많아요.
explain_en: It is a dish of several ingredients served cold and tossed in a sauce. It is often eaten with a tangy mustard or vinegar sauce and frequently comes first in a set course.

examples.ko: 사우나에서 뜨거운 탕 다음에 냉탕에 들어갔어요.
examples.en: At the sauna I got into the cold bath after the hot one.

examples.ko: 냉탕 물이 너무 차가워서 소리를 질렀어요.
examples.en: The cold bath was so cold that I screamed.
The kids played happily in the cold bath.
Going back and forth between the cold and hot baths feels refreshing.
Take a shower before you get into the cold bath.
The cold bath was like ice, so I got out quickly.

explain: 대중목욕탕에서 찬물이 담긴 탕이에요. 짝이 되는 말은 '온탕'이고, 이 둘을 같이 써서 비유하는 말도 있어요.

phrases.en: to swing between hot and cold
phrases.nuance_ko: 상황이나 분위기가 좋았다 나빴다 자주 바뀔 때 비유로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figurative way to say conditions or moods keep changing between good and bad.

explain_en: It is the bath filled with cold water at a public bathhouse. Its pair is '온탕' (hot bath), and the two are also used together in a figurative expression.

examples.ko: 올봄 냉해로 사과 농사가 큰 피해를 입었어요.
examples.en: Apple farming suffered heavy losses from this spring's cold damage.
Farmers covered the fields to prevent cold damage.
The pear blossoms all froze in the sudden cold snap.

examples.ko: 냉해가 심해서 올해는 과일 값이 올랐어요.
examples.en: Cold damage was severe, so fruit prices rose this year.
Crops hit by cold damage yield less harvest.

examples.ko: 냉해 대비를 하라는 안내 방송이 나왔어요.
examples.en: An announcement came telling people to prepare for cold damage.

explain: 봄이나 가을에 갑자기 추워져서 농작물이 입는 피해예요. 뉴스에서 '냉해를 입다'라는 말로 자주 나오고, 비슷하게 서리 때문에 생기는 피해는 '서리 피해'라고도 해요.
explain_en: It is the damage crops suffer when it suddenly turns cold in spring or autumn. In the news you hear '냉해를 입다', and damage caused by frost is also called '서리 피해'.

examples.en: This much luggage is easy enough to handle alone.
It was a game we could win with room to spare.
With my skills, passing should be no problem.
Two people can handle that job easily.

examples.ko: 아이 둘을 키우는 건 너끈하진 않지만 해낼 만해요.
examples.en: Raising two kids isn't a breeze, but it's manageable.
Thanks to my ample stamina, I finished the marathon.

explain: 힘이나 능력이 충분해서 여유가 있다는 느낌이에요. 형용사로는 덜 쓰고 '너끈히'의 모양으로 더 많이 나오고, 비슷한 말로 '거뜬하다'가 있어요.
explain_en: It gives the feeling that strength or ability is more than enough, with room to spare. It is used less as an adjective than in the form '너끈히', and a similar word is '거뜬하다'.

examples.ko: 그 정도 거리는 너끈히 걸을 수 있어요.
examples.en: I can walk that distance with no trouble.
Our team will win easily.

examples.ko: 그는 무거운 가방을 너끈히 들어 올렸어요.
examples.en: He lifted the heavy bag with ease.

examples.ko: 이 차는 다섯 명이 너끈히 탈 수 있어요.
examples.en: Five people can ride in this car comfortably.
I passed the exam without any trouble.

examples.ko: 이 정도 일은 혼자서 너끈히 해낼게요.
examples.en: I'll handle this much work on my own with ease.

explain: 어렵지 않게, 여유 있게 해낼 수 있다는 뜻으로 '수 있다, 이기다, 들다' 같은 말과 잘 어울려요. '거뜬히'와 비슷하고, 부정문보다는 긍정문에서 많이 써요.
explain_en: It means doing something without difficulty and with room to spare, and goes well with '수 있다', '이기다' and '들다'. It is similar to '거뜬히' and is used more in positive sentences than negative ones.

examples.en: During the holidays, everyone heads off to their hometowns.

examples.ko: 사람들이 너나없이 그 노래를 따라 불렀어요.
examples.en: Everyone sang along to that song.
These days everyone is just staring at their phones.
The villagers all came out and helped.
Everyone is busy these days, aren't they?
During exam season, everybody goes to the library.

explain: '누구나 다'처럼 예외 없이 모두를 말할 때 써요. '너나 할 것 없이'와 같은 뜻이고, 말하는 사람이 사람들의 공통된 모습을 짚어 이야기할 때 잘 나와요.
explain_en: It means everyone without exception, like '누구나 다'. It has the same meaning as '너나 할 것 없이' and comes up when pointing out something people all have in common.

examples.ko: 친구 너더댓 명이 우리 집에 왔어요.
examples.en: Four or five friends came to my house.
Only four or five apples are left.
You just need to wait here about four or five minutes.

examples.ko: 가게 앞에 너더댓 사람이 줄을 서 있었어요.
examples.en: Four or five people were lined up in front of the shop.
It takes four or five hours for the work to finish.

examples.ko: 지난달에 너더댓 번쯤 만난 것 같아요.
examples.en: I think we met about four or five times last month.

explain: 넷이나 다섯쯤 되는 대략의 수를 말해요. '네댓', '너덧'도 비슷한 뜻으로 쓰고, 뒤에 '명, 개, 번' 같은 단위 말이 바로 붙어요.
explain_en: It gives a rough number of about four or five. '네댓' and '너덧' are used with a similar meaning, and counters like '명', '개' and '번' follow directly.

examples.en: The hem of these long-worn pants is fraying and hanging loose.
The sole of my shoe is flapping loose, so I need to buy new ones.
The torn cloth fluttered in tatters in the wind.
I have to fix the dangling, frayed bag strap.
The sleeve was in tatters, but I wore it out anyway.
The paper stuck on the wall is hanging in shreds.

explain: 찢어지거나 해진 것이 늘어져서 흔들리는 모습에 써요. '너덜대다'도 같은 뜻으로 쓰고, '너덜너덜'과 같은 말뿌리에서 나온 짝말이에요.
explain_en: It describes something torn or worn that hangs down and swings. '너덜대다' means the same, and it is a companion word to '너덜너덜'.

examples.en: The book cover has come apart completely in tatters.
The knees of the jeans are ripped to shreds.

examples.ko: 너덜너덜 낡은 가방을 아직도 메고 다녀요.
examples.en: I still carry around that worn-out, tattered bag.
The old flag is blowing in the wind in tatters.

examples.ko: 사전이 너덜너덜 헤질 만큼 많이 봤어요.
examples.en: I used the dictionary so much that it fell apart.
The clothes were worn to rags, so I threw them away.

explain: '너덜거리다'가 늘어져 흔들리는 동작이라면 '너덜너덜'은 해지고 찢어진 모양 자체를 보여 줘요. '찢어지다, 해지다, 낡다' 같은 말과 잘 어울려요.
explain_en: '너덜거리다' is the swinging motion of something hanging loose, while '너덜너덜' shows the torn, frayed look itself. It goes well with words like '찢어지다', '해지다' and '낡다'.

examples.en: This book is so old that it's falling apart.
I'm embarrassed to go out wearing tattered clothes.
Your shoes have become tattered, so buy a new pair.
The rag that I've used for so long is in shreds.
The bag is tattered, but I still treasure it.
After working all night, I feel completely worn to shreds.

explain: 낡고 찢어져서 여기저기 늘어진 상태를 말해요. 사람이 너무 지쳤을 때 '몸이 너덜너덜해졌다'처럼 비유로도 써요.
explain_en: It describes something so worn and torn that it hangs in pieces. It is also used figuratively for exhaustion, as in '몸이 너덜너덜해졌다'.

examples.en: Neobiani was served on the feast table.
I could smell my mother grilling neobiani.

examples.ko: 이 한식 도시락에는 너비아니가 들어 있어요.
examples.en: This Korean lunch box has neobiani in it.
The kids like neobiani the most.
Neobiani and rice alone make a filling meal.
For lunch today I'll have the neobiani set meal.

explain: 양념한 소고기를 넓적하게 저며 구운 한국 음식이에요. 불고기와 비슷하다고 생각하는 사람이 많지만, 잔치나 도시락 반찬처럼 한 점씩 집어 먹는 구이로 많이 나와요.
explain_en: It is a Korean dish of seasoned beef cut into broad slices and grilled. Many people think of it as similar to bulgogi, but it often appears as a grilled side dish eaten piece by piece, as at feasts or in lunch boxes.

examples.en: He lightened the mood with some playful chatter.

examples.ko: 너스레 좀 그만 떨고 본론을 말해 봐요.
examples.en: Stop the empty chatter and get to the point.
Everyone burst out laughing at my friend's patter.

examples.ko: 너스레가 좋아서 손님들이 그 가게를 좋아해요.
examples.en: Because his patter is so good, customers like that shop.
The boss livens up the shop with his jokey talk.
It was awkward, so I tried joking around, but it was no use.

explain: 거짓말이나 과장을 섞어 능청스럽게 늘어놓는 말이에요. 보통 '너스레를 떨다'나 '너스레를 놓다'로 쓰고, 나쁜 뜻만 있는 건 아니라서 어색한 분위기를 풀려는 농담에도 써요.
explain_en: It means glib, somewhat exaggerated talk delivered with a straight face. It is usually used as '너스레를 떨다' or '너스레를 놓다', and it is not purely negative, since it can also describe jokes meant to ease an awkward mood.

examples.ko: 바다에 큰 너울이 밀려와서 배가 흔들렸어요.
examples.en: Big swells rolled in, so the boat rocked.

examples.ko: 너울 때문에 낚시 배가 출항하지 못했어요.
examples.en: The fishing boat couldn't leave port because of the swells.
A swell wave advisory has been issued.

examples.ko: 갯바위에서 너울에 휩쓸릴 수 있으니 조심하세요.
examples.en: Be careful, you could be swept away by swells on the shore rocks.
Even if the wind is weak, strong swells are dangerous.
Swells are slowly rolling in from far away.

explain: 바람이 세지 않아도 먼 바다에서 크고 완만하게 밀려오는 물결이에요. 뉴스에서는 '너울성 파도'로 자주 나오고, 같은 소리로 옛날에 얼굴을 가리던 얇은 천을 가리키기도 해요.
explain_en: It is a large, gently rising wave that rolls in from far out at sea even when the wind is not strong. In the news it appears as '너울성 파도', and the same word can also mean a thin cloth once used to cover the face.
